svg.title: If ai = 0, shrink only its radius successively by halves. The parcel masses remain equal; continuity of a finite measure from above identifies their limit with the mass of the set ki = 0, which is zero. Starting with any barrel proves w = 0. Thus every nonzero eigenwave has ai ≥1. If P i ai ≥4, the growth restriction and (TR30) again force its base barrel mass to vanish, so w = 0. The surviving waves therefore have n ≤P i ai ≤3, and (TR30) bounds their barrel masses by a constant times R6 j. Finite summation using the squared triangle inequality proves (TR25), including sector zero.
